text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I attended an academic conference held 
outside the academy to study. They were 
presenting research on Umamusume training 
theory.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you! Eager to learn as always!
choice_data_list:
I heard you were scheduled to take the 
stage too, Tucker.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, in the afternoon block. Man, talk 
about an intense atmosphere...! I'd better 
brace myself for this...!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—With that, I conclude my presentation. We 
will now move on to the Q&A session.

text_block_list.name: Researcher A
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Forgive me if this is an amateur 
question, but――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Various corporations and research 
institutions were in attendance, and 
rigorous, relentless questions flew back 
and forth. This seems to be an 
extraordinarily high-level venue...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The morning session concluded, and it was 
lunch break. Looking for Tucker Brine, I 
found her talking to herself in an empty 
space...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
――And so, as we can see, the group that 
underwent island training showed a 
significant difference, just like this...
choice_data_list: You were in the middle of practice...?!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Whoa...?! Oh, it's just you, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Haaahhh...! After seeing what happened 
this morning, well... I just couldn't 
stomach lunch, you know...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I was adjusting the contents. Shoring up 
weak points they might pick at, hoping to 
stay one step ahead... somehow, y'know...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
However... this is not a stage where cheap 
tricks will suffice, is it...? What do you 
think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing how clever she is, her research is 
bound to be flawless. In that case...
choice_data_list:
You should just push through with momentum 
like always!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Just like usual...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I see... You're right! Not carrying myself 
with pride just isn't like me...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
All right... I'm doing this... I'm gonna 
pull it off...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! Is it that time already? I-I must 
get going soon, then...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tucker Brine was fired up, but palpable 
tension still lingered on her face. Yet, 
there was no more time to lose...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, at long last, Tucker Brine's 
turn had arrived!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Driven purely by the desire to cheer her 
on, I stood in the front row! Making a 
subtle fist pump, I mouthed my 
encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: What is it? Isn't it starting yet――

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Aaaahhh~~! *Ahem-cough-hack*!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
EVERYONE GATHERED HERE! Pleasure to meet 
you! I am Tucker Brine, and I conduct 
research on off-campus facilities!!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Let's pull up the slides right away! 
Today's discussion topic is! THIS RIGHT 
HERE--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Murmur, murmur...! Her voice is so 
loud...!) (Hmph, plenty of spirit, it 
seems, but...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having regained her groove, she gave her 
presentation in her usual booming voice. 
As a result...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
—Man, that was good. Far exceeded my 
expectations. —A bit rough around the 
edges, but intriguing. Great potential 
ahead. —Wasn't that their best performance 
today?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
—Ohh, Trainer! I've been waiting for you. 
I wanted us to walk home together!
choice_data_list: Good work! That was incredible earlier!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
DAHAHAHA! Right? That Q&A session got 
pretty heated too!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
And your cheering— that truly saved me! It 
was incredibly reassuring!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Thanks to you, I was able to 
fight my own way!
